dishes.name: Thieboudienne
dishes.description: Ceebu or tiep (alternatively thieb, benechin, benachin, or jollof rice) is a traditional dish from Senegal that is also consumed in Mauritania, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Mali, The Gambia, and other West and Central African countries. It is the national dish in Senegal.

dishes.name: Méchoui
dishes.description: Méchoui (Arabic: مشوي) or meshwi is a whole sheep or lamb spit-roasted on a barbecue in Maghrebi cuisine. The word comes from the Arabic word šawā (شواء, "grilling, roasting"). This dish is common in North Africa.

dishes.name: Couscous
dishes.description: Couscous (Tamazight: ⵙⴽⵙⵓ seksu or ⴽⵙⴽⵙⵓ keskesu), is a traditional North African dish of small steamed granules of rolled semolina that is often served with a stew spooned on top.

dishes.name: Zrig
dishes.description: Zrig (Hassaniyya: زريق or زريك, zrik; Fula: toufam) is a fermented milk beverage of the west Sahara.

dishes.name: Boulaghmane
